test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Merry, convivial, hearty and good humoured
solution:
The correct answer is '**Jovial**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The one-word substitute for Merry, convivial, hearty and good-humoured is **Jovial**.
 
• Hence the correct answer is **Jovial.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The other words' meanings are;

 
• **Jowl**: the lower part of a person's or animal's cheek.
 
• **Joyous**: full of happiness and joy.
 
• **Jubilee**: a special anniversary especially: a 50th anniversary.
